name: Tempered Ringend
description: A flick of the wrist turns the dart in mid-return so it clips the opponent's cheek or ear.

name: Siltspool
description: Slide on the pivoting foot while the spare coil unwinds so the user ends beside the attack.

name: Implacable Cordlength
description: Anchor the cord round the wrist and stiffen the arm so it stops a heavy overhand blow.

name: Thornthrum
description: Cast a loop at the height of the throat so the opponent must rear back or be caught.

name: Gust Reelin
description: Whip qi through the cord so the dart travels a hard curved arc into the opponent's guard.

name: Equipoise Cordloop
description: A spiral of charged cord winds before the body and turns aside every thrust that enters it.

name: Chime Tailring
description: A loop trailing behind the dart snatches a weapon from a loosened hand as the dart passes.

name: Furrowing Dartblade
description: Qi races down the cord into the point and the dart punches through a shield or breastplate edge.

name: Hoarfrost Snapback
description: Weave the cord in tightening spirals about an opponent's torso and arms until they cannot swing.

name: Chimepluck
description: The cast follows the cord's qi field to its mark with no wobble in the dart's flight.

name: Keen Flickhand
description: Stand with coils fed by the living field and feel every body that enters it.

name: Chimethrum
description: Brush the cord upward against an incoming wrist and send the blow wide of the body.

name: Might Whipout
description: Slide one foot out along the cord's line until the dart's full reach covers the opponent.

name: Fastening Spiralcast
description: Draw a loop shut around a limb on the opponent's first step toward the user.

name: Harrowing Retrieve
description: Extend the living field a palm beyond the dart so a near miss still lands a blow.

name: Charter Darttip
description: Cords charged with the field are spread in a loose web that catches blades and darts.

name: Ponderous Dartneck
description: A tug on a field-charged loop drags the snared opponent a full stride toward the dart.

name: Glintpluck
description: Push the living field past the cord's end so the dart strikes a foe that stands out of plain reach.

name: Toxin Cordknot
description: A ring of field-charged cord laid on the ground tightens round the first foot that crosses it.

name: Silencing Ringend
description: Open with a throw that carries the cord twice round the opponent's lead arm.

name: Pluckcuirass
description: Wrap the cord about a blade's forte and pull the weapon across the opponent's own body.

name: Staunch Cordwinder
description: Hold a cord-wrapped fist before the face to take a punch on the padded turns.

name: Surging Flickhand
description: Walk a half circle round a wrapped limb so the opponent's own arm blocks their other hand.

name: Fastening Dartblade
description: Qi cinches a wrist wrap to the bone so the hand goes numb and drops what it holds.

name: Cordloop Cuirass
description: Three quick turns of charged cord pin a weapon to the user's guard arm.

name: Hoarfrost Loopcast
description: Charged cord holds an entire limb rigid at the joints for as long as the user keeps the channel.

name: Gustpluck
description: Heave on a wrapped arm and turn the hips so the opponent is thrown over the user's shoulder.

name: Scorching Dartneck
description: Open the orbit with a single swing that comes round at knee height.

name: Equipoise Cordlength
description: Let the widest part of the orbit meet a blade and bat it away from the body.

name: Equipoise Darttip
description: Pull the orbit tight against the ribs so it catches a stab that slipped past the outer ring.

name: Silt Tailring
description: Step into the orbit's gap as it passes so the opponent sees the user advance through a closed ring.

name: Severing Snapback
description: Break the orbit with a straight throw while the dart's momentum is still high.

name: Mindful Dartneck
description: Feel the orbit's pulse through the cord and know when something has disturbed its path.

name: Granite Cordwinder
description: The living field keeps the dart circling by itself so both hands are free to act.

name: Blaze Spiralcast
description: Bring the full orbit down onto the opponent's raised guard so the arm numbs under the blow.

name: Rumble Cordknot
description: Spin the orbit sharply to shake off a hand that has seized the cord.

name: Unmaking Tempered Loopcast
description: Two orbits turn at different heights and cross on the opponent so neither can be blocked alone.

name: Thornpluck
description: Tighten the orbit inward round the opponent until the circling cord pins their arms to their sides.

name: Loopcast Thrash
description: Cast the dart along the rim of an imagined bowl so it curves in to the target.

name: Iron Whipout
description: Swing the dart in a slow bend like a river's turn and let it strike on the outer curve.

name: Quelling Reelin
description: Let the cord settle round a forearm and hold it at the school's measured tension.

name: Unflinching Dartblade
description: Both hands hold the cord across the body so one catches what the other misses.

name: Torrent Spiralcast
description: Glide forward on flat feet like a wader crossing a shallow ford without a splash.

name: Verity Cordknot
description: Read the ground through the cord's tip as a student reads a basin's floor for slope.

name: Novareelin
description: Send dart and loose cord on two tracks so the dart strikes while the cord wraps.

name: Ponderous Cordloop
description: A steady drag on the snared limb moves the opponent like a swimmer taken by a current.

name: Gust Cordwinder
description: Turn the cord along an imagined rim so blows slide round the user rather than through.

name: Glinttine
description: Raise the dart high then drop it straight down point-first like a hawk stooping on prey.

name: Skinning Tempered Darttip
description: Two courses of the dart run side by side and the second takes whoever dodged the first.

name: Thorntine
description: Strung cord rises round the ground like the walls of a basin and closes on whoever steps inside.

name: Nova Retrieve
description: Open the exchange by sending the dart down one track while the cord prepares the other.

name: Ponderous Reelin
description: Two wraps lie on the limb side by side so a single twist cannot undo both.

name: Thorn Flickhand
description: Hold one straight line of cord before the face and a second behind it.

name: Mighttine
description: Move with two paces to every one throw so the feet and the dart keep separate rhythms.

name: Mayhem Snapback
description: Show the opponent one track with the cord and strike on the other with the dart.

name: Hamstringing Tailring
description: Answer a lunge by running the cord along the lunge's own track and binding the arm.

name: Thorn Cordlength
description: Two orbits of charged cord turn in opposite senses and shear away strikes from either side.

name: Lancereelin
description: Two charged tracks of the dart cross inside the opponent's guard and the point drives through.

name: Thrumhauberk
description: Two matched snares lie mirrored on either side of a path so a sidestep from one springs the other.

name: Cleaving Dartneck
description: Climb the dart on a high swing and let it fall on the target in a single stoop.

name: Hamstringing Snapback
description: A loose tether flows round a limb and settles with the quiet of slow water.

name: Murkspool
description: Bend the cord like a reed in a current so a blade passes without finding purchase.

name: Vaulting Retrieve
description: Dip one shoulder like a banking hawk and step off the line as the dart swings clear.

name: Cordwinder Tincture
description: Sight along the cord as along a waterline to see whether the ground ahead falls or rises.

name: Might Cordknot
description: Lift the dart from below in a hawk's climb and strike the chin as it peaks.

name: Hoarfrost Ringend
description: Pull low on a snared ankle so the opponent's footing is taken from beneath them.

name: Iron Dartblade
description: Hold the tether in a taut vertical line so a charging foe meets its sting.

name: Glint Whipout
description: Drive the charged dart down in the hawk's final stoop and pin armor to the ground beneath it.

name: Fastening Darttip
description: Stake cord across a path like a weir so those who wade through are slowed and tangled.

name: Nova Whipout
description: Cast the dart with the wind in the cord's hum and let the flight take the rest.

name: Granite Tailring
description: Take a bearing on the opponent and step along it until the cord's reach is true.

name: Murk Flickhand
description: Turn the cord to the weather side so blows glance off it like gusts off a post.

name: Gyve Ringend
description: A loop thrown low at the edge of footing takes the heel and tips the opponent.

name: Granite Cordlength
description: Lash the cord in the full pull of a gale so the dart strikes like a thrown stone.

name: Fastening Reelin
description: Hold a snared limb along one unwavering line for as long as the student keeps the channel.

name: Spooltorment
description: Let qi catch a crosswind so the dart curves round a shield and into the open flank.

name: Deedthrum
description: Cord pegged across open ground without walls takes the foot of any rider or runner who crosses.

name: Facet Cordloop
description: Cast the dart along the line of a plateau's rim where the opponent has no room to dodge.

name: Spoolsprint
description: Walk the narrow rim with the cord held as a balance line in one hand.

name: Hardened Flickhand
description: Parry with the cord set against the wind off the edge so the blade is pushed wide.

name: Ponderous Spiralcast
description: A loop drops over an opponent at the edge and takes up the slack as they stumble.

name: Aegis Dartneck
description: Set the dart's weight behind a stone and lean back on the cord against a pulling foe.

name: Verityspool
description: Pause with the cord hanging loose and let its sway report the wind and the foe together.

name: Retrieve Torment
description: Let the dart fall over the edge and snap it up so it strikes from below the footing.

name: Staunch Ringend
description: Brace the body on a held cord against a shove that would send a student over the edge.

name: Reelinsprint
description: Ride a rising gust on the cord to clear a gap or a low wall of stone in one bound.

name: Ironpluck
description: Hurl the charged dart off the edge and haul it up under the opponent's lifted guard.

name: Silttine
description: Pegged tethers lie hidden in the grass and close on any boot that crosses them.

name: Cleaving Loopcast
description: Cast along a held bearing so the dart flies on the same line however the wind shifts.

name: Subduing Cordknot
description: Close a loop that the student does not loosen until the foe yields or falls.

name: Aegis Dartblade
description: Hold the cord steady along the bearing so a blow meeting it finds no give.

name: Mightthrum
description: Advance on a single heading without turning aside for feints or flung dust.

name: Chime Cordloop
description: Check the cord's hang against the held bearing to learn how far the foe has moved.

name: Pluckgreave
description: Turn into the wind with the cord outstretched and knock a thrust from its line.

name: Reelin Assault
description: Send the dart straight down the held bearing so its point arrives where the foe must stand.

name: Crippling Spiralcast
description: A cinch that sets at the first struggle and holds with a stiffness of qi.

name: Resilient Cordlength
description: Hold the cord point-first so that a charge divides round it like wind round a pole.

name: Hastening Darttip
description: Take the wind at the back and surge a long stride toward the foe with the dart trailing.

name: Glintthrum
description: A qi-charged dart travels one sworn line with no deviation through shield and guard.

name: Hoarfrost Cordwinder
description: Lock a limb along the bearing and draw the foe step by step along it.
